Messages.Author: David Cherryholmes
Messages.Body:
Sorry if this is a FAQ, but the only direct discussion I could dig up
involving LSJ was circa 1996. Since ToV is played after strike resolution,
and the damage from Riposte is inflicted just after combat ends, there is no
opportunity to play ToV, correct? Provision of Siscilla, OTOH, is playable,
as it is a Reaction/Action Mod. Lastly, Pulled Fangs is played per current
card text, not during the press phase anymore, so it would also be a legal
play after a Riposte?

David Cherryholmes
Prince of Durham

Messages.Author: LSJ

> card text, not during the press phase anymore, so it would also be a legal

Sure, but wouldn't count the after-combat damage done by Riposte. PF is
played as combat is ending.
